drafted_from: tools/social-posts/tool-rows.json (tool:read-youtube-comments), tools/social-posts/test/youtube-connection.test.mjs and the row's request and fields mask; the answer is worked out from the row, not observed
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the comments on my YouTube video vid-aaa, newest first, and tell me which ask a question." It runs tool:read-youtube-comments with my YouTube connection and that video id.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads one video's comment threads through your YouTube connection and posts, rates and moderates nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect your YouTube account (service_connection:youtube, or service_connection:youtube:<name>).
2. Get the video id: tool:list-my-youtube-videos gives each video's id.
3. Say "Read the comments on that video": the AI runs tool:read-youtube-comments at @workshop-tools with {account_id, video_id}, once for each video.

4. Read the answer: threads, newest first, 100 to a page, each with the comment's text, like count, publish time, reply count and the commenter's channel id (no display name). Pass nextPageToken as page_token for the next page, until none comes back. A video with comments turned off comes back as YouTube's refusal.

worked_examples.title: Two comments on one video
worked_examples.ask: Read the comments on my YouTube video vid-aaa.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/social-posts/tool-rows.json (the row's http request and its fields mask), not run live: the engine sends GET https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/commentThreads with videoId=vid-aaa, order=time, maxResults=100, textFormat=plainText and the fields mask nextPageToken,items(id,snippet(totalReplyCount,topLevelComment(snippet(textDisplay,likeCount,publishedAt,authorChannelId)))); the connection's token goes only to www.googleapis.com. The video (synthetic) has two comments.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"items":[{"id":"Ugx1","snippet":{"totalReplyCount":0,"topLevelComment":{"snippet":{"textDisplay":"what is the price","likeCount":1,"publishedAt":"2030-11-12T11:00:00Z","authorChannelId":{"value":"UCfan"}}}}},{"id":"Ugx2","snippet":{"totalReplyCount":0,"topLevelComment":{"snippet":{"textDisplay":"Love this loaf","likeCount":3,"publishedAt":"2030-11-12T09:30:00Z","authorChannelId":{"value":"UCother"}}}}}]} (values synthetic; the fields are exactly the ones the mask keeps). This is the shape tool:decide-the-replies reads for YouTube comments.
